quote: When PostgreSQL loses its connection during COMMIT, the new write path throws a canonical SqliteWorkerError and this backend catches it into encodeWorkboardSqliteFailure. The outer worker then V8-serializes the envelope.
note: The P2 finding on uncertain-outcome classification traced the same disconnect through the Workboard worker’s error reply. Preserving the error classification would still leave the worker holding the closed kernel and subsequent requests failing.
